Grotti '95 Cheetah (Ultimate Edition Reward) — GTA 6 guide

Confirmed by multiple launch guides · not personally verified Tequesta Retreat, Vice City

A Miami Vice icon is handed to Ultimate Edition owners late in the story — no theft required.

Full guide — contains spoilers

The Grotti '95 Cheetah, a Testarossa-style nod to Miami Vice, is an Ultimate Edition reward rather than a steal: it waits in the underground garage of Pegassi Residences in Tequesta Retreat and becomes available in Chapter 5. If you own the Ultimate Edition it is yours to claim — but not free to keep: registering it costs $32,750 (it sells for $16,775). The unlock mission is named 'Honest Abe' by a single source (GTA6Wiki); other guides tie the Pegassi garage itself to Operation Savage Glory, so treat the mission name as unverified.

Source & evidence

Source: GTA 6 unique cars: best ones, where they are, how to keep — LeonidaHub (2026-11-22).

Evidence: Aggregated guide citing IGN and gta6notebook for edition, chapter and location. Ultimate Edition / Chapter 5 / Pegassi Residences placement confirmed by multiple post-launch lists; the $32,750 registration is also recorded in this site's Chapter 5 guide (via Exputer). 'Honest Abe' is single-source (GTA6Wiki) and disputed.
